aboutGame.title: What Is Tulsa King Season 4?
paragraphs: Tulsa King Season 4 is the fourth chapter of Paramount+'s crime drama starring Sylvester Stallone as Dwight "The General" Manfredi. After building a criminal operation in Tulsa, Dwight tries to legitimize his empire while corrupt politicians, dangerous rivals, and a devastating personal loss close in. The ten-episode season premiered on Friday, October 16, 2026, with "W.W.D.D." and releases weekly on Fridays.

The series counts Taylor Sheridan among its executive producers and Terence Winter as head writer and executive producer. Returning allies include Martin Starr as Bodhi, Jay Will as Tyson, Garrett Hedlund as Mitch, Dana Delany as Margaret Devereaux, and Annabella Sciorra as Joanne, while Gretchen Mol joins as a new series regular. Our fan guide tracks the episode schedule, cast, plot threads, trailer details, and Paramount+ viewing options.

faq.title: Tulsa King Season 4 FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers about the Tulsa King Season 4 premiere, episode schedule, cast, and streaming availability.

items.question: What is Tulsa King Season 4 about?
items.answer: Tulsa King Season 4 follows Dwight Manfredi as he tries to legitimize his criminal empire while corrupt politicians, dangerous new enemies, and a crushing personal loss threaten his crew and his control of Tulsa.

items.question: When does Tulsa King Season 4 premiere?
items.answer: Tulsa King Season 4 premiered on Friday, October 16, 2026, with the episode "W.W.D.D." on Paramount+.

items.question: How many episodes are in Tulsa King Season 4?
items.answer: Tulsa King Season 4 has ten episodes. New episodes arrive weekly on Fridays, with the finale projected for December 18, 2026.

items.question: Where can I watch Tulsa King Season 4?
items.answer: In the United States, Tulsa King Season 4 streams on Paramount+. Availability in other regions can vary, so check the official Paramount+ listing for your location.

items.question: Who leads the cast of Tulsa King Season 4?
items.answer: Sylvester Stallone leads Tulsa King Season 4 as Dwight "The General" Manfredi. Martin Starr, Jay Will, Garrett Hedlund, Dana Delany, Annabella Sciorra, and Chris Caldovino return, while Gretchen Mol joins as a new series regular.

items.question: Will there be a Tulsa King Season 5 after Season 4?
items.answer: Yes. Season 5 is already filming in New York while Tulsa King Season 4 continues its weekly release on Paramount+.
